name: navigator-scan-permission-coherence-test
body:
The coherence e2e test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `code_type = 'test'`) pins the navigator's scan-permission grant in the embedded `codebase-navigator.md` prompt. The prompt's frontmatter grants `apg_scan: ask`, and the embedded agent set holds `apg_scan: ask` as its sole scan grant, so opencode's user permission prompt gates a scan. The prompt's stale-graph refresh intent holds: it directs the agent to run `apg_scan`, whose `ask` permission is the user-facing gate. The test asserts the frontmatter `apg_scan: ask` grant is the prompt's sole scan gate. The test additionally pins the navigator's `apg_review_action: allow` grant and the coordinator dispatch/action protocol.

The component owns the test's scan-permission needle surface. It is distinct from `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`, which owns the prompt file 1:1 and is implemented-by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, and from the sibling `solution.component.navigator-isolation-coherence-test`, which owns the test's session-isolation needle surface. It sits under `solution.container.scanner-cli`, the root-crate test surface.

implemented-by: `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `code_type = 'test'`).
